children: Toronto, Ontario – TheNewswire - September 2, 2026 – Hybrid Power Solutions Inc.

(FSE: E092) (“Hybrid” or the “Company”), an emerging leader in fuel-free clean power solutions, is pleased to announce the filing of a comprehensive patent application for a groundbreaking AI-driven energy management system. This innovation is designed to optimize hybrid power deployments integrating battery storage, renewables, generators, and grid connections for industrial, remote, and mission-critical applications.
The patent application details a sophisticated system featuring:
A communication interface supporting multiple protocols including Modbus and CANbus.
A sensor interface integrating GPS, accelerometers, humidity, Hall effect current sensors, voltage, acoustic, Bluetooth, and Wi-Fi capabilities.

A machine learning engine that analyzes power consumption and generation patterns to generate autonomous control actions, continuously learning from operational data to optimize efficiency without user intervention.
Predictive maintenance capabilities using feature extraction, degradation trend analysis, and remaining useful life estimation.
Dynamic weighting for optimization objectives, contextual adjustments (e.g., electricity prices, carbon intensity), and confidence scoring for AI decisions with human review triggers.
Renewable energy management with advanced MPPT, wind turbine control, microgrid coordination, and unified management of solar, wind, battery storage, and controllable loads.
Extreme weather preparation, power quality monitoring per IEEE standards, fault compensation, simulation modeling, and more.

Francois Byrne, CEO of Hybrid Power Solutions, commented: “This patent application represents a major leap forward in intelligent hybrid power systems. By embedding AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and real-time optimization, we are enabling our customers to achieve superior efficiency, lower operating costs, reduced emissions, and enhanced reliability—especially in harsh or remote environments where our Spark, Batt Pack, and Solar Tarp solutions are already making an impact. This technology will further differentiate Hybrid in the market and support our transition toward smarter, more autonomous clean power platforms. This could be a new source of recurring revenue once implemented across the product line.”

The system aligns closely with Hybrid’s ongoing development of its embedded IoT and unified fleet management platform, which incorporates predictive analytics and machine learning for remote monitoring and optimization. It also complements tools like the Company’s new customer-facing power usage calculator, which helps users evaluate hybrid solutions, estimate ROI, cost savings, payback periods, and CO₂ reductions based on real-world data.

This filing underscores Hybrid’s commitment to innovation in portable and hybrid energy storage, building on prior intellectual property achievements and positioning the Company for expanded opportunities in construction, mining, defense, First Nations microgrids, and other high-demand sectors.

Hybrid Power Solutions Inc. is a Canadian clean energy innovator listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange under the symbol "HPSS." The Company specializes in developing portable power systems that eliminate the need for fossil fuels in off-grid and remote applications. With a focus on environmental responsibility and technological innovation, Hybrid Power Solutions is committed to leading the clean energy transition.
